Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so the return value differs but owner is still correctly set. (This does NOT change owner and is excluded per the target, so removed in final list.)
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = owner;` so owner remains unchanged.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = msg.sender;` so owner becomes the caller instead of the argument.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = admin;` so owner becomes the admin address.
Delete the assignment `owner = _owner;` so owner is never changed.
Delete the `onlyAdmin` modifier from setOwner so anyone can call it.
Replace `require(msg.sender == admin, "Only admin can call address(this) function");` with `require(true, "Only admin can call address(this) function");` so onlyAdmin always passes.
Replace `require(msg.sender == admin, ...)` with `require(msg.sender != admin, ...)` so only non-admin can call.
Delete the require statement in onlyAdmin, removing the access control.
Return a constant false expression instead of true.
Delete the return statement so function returns default bool false.
Remove the require check from the onlyAdmin modifier, making it always pass.
Change the require condition to always true, disabling the admin restriction.
Change the require condition to allow any caller, not just admin.
